out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Record System, Label/Tags
violations.observation: Inadequate record keeping system of molluscan shellfish tags. The tags for the molluscan shellfish are not available or are discarded immediately after the container is empty.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock tags shall remain attached to the container in which the shellstock are received until the container is empty. If you separate the clams make sure to make copies and keep tag information in each container.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed steamed broccoli in unit # 5 at 44F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded steamed broccoli

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 165F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 165F for a stationary rack single temperature machine. The thermostat read 153F.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F. CFM will sanitized all tableware, utensils, cookware in the three compartment sink until the dish machine is repaired.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Feta cheese, artichoke, roast mushrooms in unit # 7 at 53, 53, 53, Milk in unit # 6 at 50F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded Feta cheese, artichoke, roast mushrooms from unit # 7, Milk from unit # 6 and will discontinue the use of units #6 and #7 until are repaired.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Observed squeeze bottles through the kitchen with no labels.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM labeled the squeeze bottles.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Observed unit # 6 at 43F and unit #7 at 45F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM will adjust/repaired unit # 6 and unit # 7 and do not use the units until they are repaired.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: cooked marinara, that was prepared the day before, was observed at 50f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC THREW AWAY THE MARINARA THAT WAS COOKED THE THAT COOLED IMPROPERLY.
